start: HQ open on any page; the read log pulls have failed for over an hour

steps.action: Open HQ (All gyms opens by default)
user_sees: Red line on top: 'Read log is not working since <time>: <reason>. Supabase keeps its logs only about a day, so direct looks at gym data are not being recorded. Fix it today.'
must_not: The page shown with no warning while the read log is failing

steps.action: Go to another page from the menu (Needs you, Payments, a gym page)
user_sees: The same red line on top of that page too
must_not: The warning only on the first page

steps.action: Fix the read log, keep HQ open for a minute (the page asks every minute)
user_sees: The red line goes away by itself
must_not: A red line that stays after the read log works again
A reload needed to clear it

start: HQ open; no logs key saved

user_sees: Grey line on top: 'Read log is off: no logs key saved.'
must_not: A red alarm for a switched-off read log
The line counted in the Needs you number

start: HQ open; the Supabase logs key ends within the renew window

user_sees: Amber line: 'The logs key ends on <date>. In Supabase, make a new “Logs read” token for the MettleUp project and paste it into Add a key as SUPABASE_LOGS_TOKEN. Then tell Claude its end date.'
must_not: 'ends' after the end date has passed (it must say 'ended')

start: HQ open; the read log is failing; then a page fails to load (no internet or a server error)

steps.action: Open a gym page while the server cannot answer
user_sees: A plain error note in place of the page
must_not: The read-log warning disappearing from the top while the read log is still failing

steps.action: The minute check of the warnings also fails
user_sees: The last warning stays as it was
must_not: The warning cleared as if all is fine

start: Read log working, then failing, then fixed

steps.action: Read log pulls start failing; wait under an hour
must_not: A red line after a single failed pull

steps.action: Pulls keep failing past an hour; HQ checks again
user_sees: Red line 'Read log is not working since <time>...'
must_not: A start time that moves each minute

steps.action: Pulls work again; HQ checks again
must_not: The red line left on screen

user_sees: Only the read log state and its reason; no gym name, no member data
must_not: Gym or member data in the warning

user_sees: The words say direct looks at gym data are not being recorded
must_not: The promise that every look is recorded silently broken for more than a day with no warning
